ai.title: AI assistant
ai.connectionFailedHint: Codex was found, but its local service could not start. Retry the connection or choose another executable below.
ai.codexRequiredHint: Install the official Codex CLI with one click, or provide codex.exe. Installation downloads from npm and needs Node.js, npm, and an internet connection; it stays inside TeXWeave's user-data folder and does not change global PATH. Authentication is stored separately by TeXWeave.
ai.connectHint: Sign in through OpenAI in your browser. TeXWeave never receives or stores your password or access token.
ai.installCopilot: Install GitHub Copilot CLI for TeXWeave
ai.copilotRequired: GitHub Copilot CLI is required to sign in
ai.copilotRequiredHint: Install the official Copilot CLI into TeXWeave's user-data folder, then sign in with GitHub. Installing through npm requires Node.js 22+, npm, and an internet connection; it does not change the system PATH.
ai.copilotConnectHint: Sign in with GitHub to use Copilot Chat. Copilot can edit the project snapshot; TeXWeave presents its changes for review before applying them to your project.
ai.chatPhaseHint: Chat keeps local conversation history and only receives editor context you choose to include.
ai.codexPhaseHint: Codex works on a private project snapshot. Review proposed edits before applying them.
ai.connectedToCodex: Connected through the local Codex App Server.
ai.confirmClearChat: Delete this conversation and its local AI changes?
ai.confirmProjectScope: Confirm the current project scope before starting Codex.
ai.codexScopeTitle: Codex can work in this project snapshot
ai.codexScopeBody: Chat and Codex can read this project's source and text files and propose edits. Review the diff before applying changes.
ai.codexScopeSafety: The original project folder is not directly writable by the AI process.
ai.readProjectHint: Share supported TeX/text files and unsaved editor buffers for this turn.
ai.allowEditsHint: Codex edits an isolated copy; review the diff and approve before applying to your project.
ai.projectNotShared: Project files are not shared with Codex. Turn on project reading above to include them.
ai.inlineDiffTitle: AI proposed changes — review in the AI panel
ai.chatReady: Ask GitHub Copilot about this project or request an edit. Copilot works in a project snapshot, and TeXWeave shows changes for review before applying them.
ai.codexReady: Describe a change for the current project. Codex can inspect and edit the project workspace.
ai.projectSnapshotNote: Project source, configuration, TeX/text files, and unsaved editor tabs are available as context. Review diffs, apply changes, and undo them at any time.
ai.changesApplied: Accepted changes are in the editor buffer. Save with Ctrl+S to write them to disk.
ai.undoConflict: {{path}} changed after applying AI edits; it was left untouched.
ai.undoNoLongerAvailable: This AI change is no longer the most recent apply and cannot be safely undone.
ai.acceptOneChange: Accept at least one change before applying.
ai.confirmDeleteFile: Delete {{path}} from this project? This action applies immediately.
ai.bufferConflict: {{path}} changed since the AI snapshot. Its proposal was not applied.
ai.hunkConflict: Could not safely match the proposed change in {{path}}. Nothing was applied.
settings.aiPrivacyHint: Choose Copilot or Codex. Ordinary edits apply automatically in the default permission mode; review and accept or discard them. Accepted edits use the editor’s normal undo history.
settings.aiChangeReviewDetails: AI edits are shown as source diffs. You can review changes individually or in batches, apply the ones you want, and undo applied changes.
settings.aiIncludeCurrentFile: Include the current file in Chat by default
settings.aiPermissionDetails: Web research is available in every mode. Ask mode reviews project changes before application; automatic mode applies ordinary edits for review. Full access also permits external file writes without confirmation.
ai.permission.ask.description: Review project edits before applying. Ask before external file writes or risky actions; web research is available.
ai.permission.auto.description: Apply ordinary project edits automatically. Ask before risky or external write operations; web research is available.
ai.permission.full.description: Allow file and network access without confirmation. Only tracked project edits are reviewable.
ai.permission.full.confirm: Full access allows AI to modify files anywhere on this computer and use the network without asking. External actions cannot be undone through the project editor. Continue?
ai.autoApplyConflict: Automatic apply paused; review this proposal.
ai.changeUnavailable: This change is no longer available in the current project.
